answer_1.quote: PHONITALE performs the task of retrieving crosslingual phonologically similar keyword sequence and using them to construct a L1 verbal cue for a given L2 target word
answer_1.outputs: verbal cues in L1 (Korean) that link phonologically similar L1 keywords to the meaning of an L2 (English) word

answer_2.quote: We validate the module using two metrics: Character Error Rate (CER) and Exact Match Rate (EMR)

answer_3.quote: We assess the correctness of recognition and generation response using LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o)
criteria: alignment between model output and answer

answer_4.quote: We recruit Korean-native adults with intermediate English proficiency through university communities and LinkedIn
answer_4.guideline: Participants rate each verbal cue on three aspects on a 5-point Likert scale: helpfulness, coherence, and imageability
